Bundle: One row per OPTION. Repeat the Bundle name on every row, or merge the cell — either works.
Put the feature settings (DisplayType, Min/MaxSelections, SortOrder) on the FIRST row of each feature only.
The second bundle above shows a fixed-price bundle. Both are valid; pick the one that matches how the bundle is sold.

BundleCode: The bundle name. Repeat it on every row of that bundle.
Product code for the bundle itself. First row only.
RollUp | HeaderPriced | Mixed. First row only. Blank means RollUp — see below.
The heading the rep sees. Repeat it for every option in that feature.
The safest way to name a product. An exact code beats an exact name.
Used when there is no code. Must match EXACTLY — a partial match is refused, not guessed.
Radio | Checkbox | Dropdown. Radio and Dropdown return ONE selection and need a Default.
How many the rep must pick. 0 means the whole feature is optional.
How many the rep may pick. Blank means no cap. MUST be 1 for Radio and Dropdown.
Y = selected when the bundle opens. A Radio feature with MinSelections 1 and no Default is an ERROR.
Y = the rep cannot remove this option once the feature is in play.
Priced | Included | Informational. Blank means Priced.
Included | Promotional | ZeroRated | Trial. Only meaningful when PricingRole is Included or Informational.
Static | Match with Parent | Variable | Match with Other Option. Blank means Static.
Used with Match with Parent / Match with Other Option. 4 = four of these per one of that.
Product name or code of an option in THIS bundle that must also be selected.
Product name or code of an option in THIS bundle that must NOT be selected alongside.
What the rep is shown when a Requires/Excludes rule blocks them. Leave blank and they get blocked with no explanation.

Bundle: RollUp — each option carries its own price and the total is their sum. This is the default and is right most of the time.
HeaderPriced — the bundle has ONE price. Mark every option Included, or the customer pays twice.
Mixed — the bundle has a base price AND some options charge on top. Mark those Priced and the rest Included.
Leave PricingMode blank if you are unsure. RollUp is how every bundle behaved before this column existed.
